examples.description: Log a call by contact NAME (no id lookup needed)

failure_modes.recovery: The error carries the runnable contact_upsert call — create-or-merge the contact, then retry.
failure_modes.when: contact_id does not name a contact in your tenant, or no contact matches the given contact_name/contact_email/contact_phone

failure_modes.recovery: The error lists the candidate ids — retry with contact_id.
failure_modes.when: contact_name matches MORE than one contact

preconditions: Logging an activity bumps the contact's last_contact_at (freshness) — omit occurred_at for 'now'.
No contact_id handy? Pass contact_name, contact_email or contact_phone instead — a unique match resolves to the id server-side.
occurred_at accepts "YYYY-MM-DD" (parsed server-side as UTC midnight) or epoch milliseconds.

description: Log an interaction — call, meeting, email, message, visit, payment, or other — against a contact. The ONE activity-logging door every lane funnels through, so the contact's last_contact_at freshness bumps no matter which surface logged the touch; the bump never moves backward, so importing older history can never regress a fresher touch. Accepts contact_name, contact_email or contact_phone in place of contact_id. NEXT: contact_read to see the bumped last_contact_at.

contact_email.description: Resolves the contact by exact email when contact_id is absent.

contact_name.description: No contact_id handy? Resolves the contact by exact name — a unique match wins; ambiguity refuses with the candidate ids.

contact_phone.description: Resolves the contact by exact phone when contact_id is absent.

name: interaction_create
